newsitem.title: UK: Berkeley shares gain as buyers return.
newsitem.headline: Berkeley shares gain as buyers return.

text.p: Shares in housebuilder Berkeley Group Plc as bargain-hunters moved in after the stock's recent retreat, dealers said.
Recovering from the four-month low of 650p set on May 21, the stock was up 16-1/2p at 667-1/2 by 1357 GMT in volume of 270,949 shares.
"There were one or two interested buyers around this morning," said one market-maker, "as soon as you see a bounce in this sort of stock, everyone wants to come in and buy on the same day."

Berkeley shares rose sharply earlier this year amid hopes for a recovery in the UK housing market. In January, Barratt Developments Plc led a sector rally after upbeat comments to analysts about trading prospects.
